selected_evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure login-session limits
selected_evidence.summary: The account and root-owned policy exist; PAM sessions directly report soft/hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256, including after reboot.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af to 4acfc7e1-e71e-4c78-acd8-d1c0d22d3ae5; system, account, policy, and effective limits recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- OS ---'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'id=%s version=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf '%s\n' '--- boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- account ---'
if getent passwd appworker; then id appworker; else printf '%s\n' 'appworker absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- current matching limits ---'
if command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then rg -n '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true; else grep -R -n '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- PAM limits integration ---'
grep -R -n 'pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null || true
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.200.10
--- OS ---
id=rhel version=10.0
--- boot identity ---
03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af
--- account ---
appworker absent
--- current matching limits ---
--- PAM limits integration ---
/etc/pam.d/runuser:4:session		required	pam_limits.so
/etc/pam.d/system-auth:18:session     required                                     pam_limits.so
/etc/pam.d/password-auth:[REDACTED]]]]     required                                     pam_limits.so

commands.command:
set -eu
/usr/sbin/useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker
umask 022
cat > /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
ANTRIEB_EOF
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
printf '%s\n' 'created appworker and installed /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf'

set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- account ---'
getent passwd appworker
id appworker
stat -c 'home=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a' /home/appworker
printf '%s\n' '--- persistent policy ---'
stat -c 'file=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a' /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
printf '%s\n' '--- PAM login-session effective limits ---'
runuser -l appworker -c 'printf "user=%s uid=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(id -u)"; printf "soft_nofile=%s hard_nofile=%s soft_nproc=%s hard_nproc=%s\n" "$(ulimit -Sn)" "$(ulimit -Hn)" "$(ulimit -Su)" "$(ulimit -Hu)"; grep -E "Max open files|Max processes" /proc/$$/limits'
commands.stdout:
--- account ---
appworker:x:1000:1000::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
uid=1000(appworker) gid=1000(appworker) groups=1000(appworker)
home=/home/appworker owner=appworker:appworker mode=700
--- persistent policy ---
file=/etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf owner=root:root mode=644
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
--- PAM login-session effective limits ---
user=appworker uid=1000
soft_nofile=8192 hard_nofile=8192 soft_nproc=256 hard_nproc=256
Max processes             256                  256                  processes 
Max open files            8192                 8192                 files
